singleSourced.value: I beelined to a waypoint in a very fast car, maybe buying a new gun on the way.
singleSourced.context:
The story of a journey in GTA is usually "I beelined to a waypoint in a very fast car, maybe buying a new gun on the way."

The flip side of introducing complexity to GTA is that some folks will be caught off guard (or put off) by new points of friction.

singleSourced.value: not participate or engage with these kinds of actions.
singleSourced.context:
In response, Stop Killing Games has now issued a statement disavowing the whole thing and urging its followers to "not participate or engage with these kinds of actions."

Stop Killing Games said the leaks appear genuine, noting the speed with which GTA publisher Take-Two Interactive has been issuing copyright strikes against them.

singleSourced.key: attaching crypto links and qr codes to the footage and asking people to pay for more
singleSourced.value: attaching crypto links and QR codes to the footage and asking people to pay for more.
singleSourced.context:
Be that as it may, it also pointed out that the leaker is using the leak to promote a memecoin, "attaching crypto links and QR codes to the footage and asking people to pay for more."

"Do not send these people your money, no matter how much sympathy you may feel for their actions," Stop Killing Games said in a statement posted on Reddit.
